up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL2938 (Protein kinase C gamma type). The query must join the activities table with the assays table (to get assay ChEMBL ID), target_dictionary (to filter by target CHEMBL ID), and compound_structures (to get canonical SMILES). Filter conditions: 1) The activity standard relation must be exactly '='. 2) The pChEMBL value must be non-null. 3) The standard type must be 'IC50'. Output columns: assay_chembl_id, target_type (from target_dictionary), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id and then by assay_chembl_id. Limit the result to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type AS target_type,
  td.tax_id AS tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type AS standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2938'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id,
  ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000
